sensor.title: PixArt PAW3395 Advanced Sensor Settings
sensor.subtitle: Low-level optical calibration, motion smoothing, and tracking surface control
sensor.lodDesc: Determines the height at which the optical sensor stops tracking when lifted.
sensor.debounceDesc: Hardware anti-double-click delay filter. Lower time = lower click latency.
sensor.motionSyncDesc: Synchronizes PAW3395 optical readings exactly with the PC USB polling intervals.
sensor.angleSnappingDesc: Predicts and forces straight-line movements. Keep disabled for competitive FPS.
sensor.rippleControlDesc: Eliminates high-DPI jitter smoothing at ultra-high sensitivities (>10,000 DPI).
sensor.saveSuccess: Sensor configuration written to mouse on-board flash memory.

pairing.title: 2.4G Wireless Pairing (FastConnect)
pairing.subtitle: Direct radio-frequency synchronization tool between mouse and USB receiver
pairing.fastConnectDesc: Use this wizard if you replaced the USB receiver or if the mouse lost RF synchronization.
pairing.step1Desc: Insert the 2.4GHz dongle directly into a PC USB port.
pairing.step2Desc: Slide the switch on the bottom of the mouse to '2.4G'.
pairing.step3Desc: Place the mouse within 10 cm of the receiver and click 'Start Pairing'.
pairing.searching: Scanning RF channels for mouse... Time elapsed:
pairing.timeout: Timeout reached with no response from mouse.

diagnostics.title: Hardware Diagnostics & Real-time Benchmark
diagnostics.subtitle: Test switch actuation, scroll encoder steps, and live USB report rate.
diagnostics.moveRapidly: Move mouse rapidly inside this box to benchmark
diagnostics.vsyncNote: 💡 Note on Polling Rate & Screen V-Sync: The mouse hardware communicates with the USB bus at 1000 Hz (1ms). In webviews and browsers, standard UI cursor events are synchronized with your monitor refresh rate (e.g. 60Hz = ~16.6ms intervals). Coalesced high-speed hardware reports are aggregated per display frame.

settings.persistenceDesc: Automatically synchronize profile memory both locally and to device flash.
